test_concat_with_group_keys: test the concat function with group keys to create MultiIndex on axis 0 and axis 1
test_concat_copy: test the concat function preserves memory views when concatenating DataFrames along axis 1
test_concat_iterables: test the concat function works with tuples generators deques and custom iterators
test_concat_mapping: test the concat function accepts dict and non-dict mapping subclasses as input
test_concat_of_series_and_frame: test the concat function mixes Series and DataFrames with ignore_index and axis parameters
test_concat_keys_and_levels: test the concat function with explicit keys and levels parameters for MultiIndex construction
test_concat_bool_types: test the concat function handles dtype coercion between bool and boolean types
test_concat_empty_and_non_empty_frame: test the concat function handles empty and non-empty DataFrames without regression
test_concat_keys_with_none: test the concat function filters out None values from dict and list inputs
test_concat_preserves_subclass: test the concat function preserves DataFrame and Series subclass types
